meta.title: Careers
meta.description: Join Pipeline Studio — a remote-first team of engineers and designers building visual infrastructure for event-driven automation.

hero.title: Build the future of visual development
hero.description: We are a small, senior team of engineers, designers and product people shipping a next-generation platform for visual workflows. If you love hard problems and clean interfaces — you will feel at home here.

perks.title: Why you will love it here
perks.description: We optimize for deep work, ownership and low process overhead. No pointless meetings, no politics.

remote.title: Remote-first
remote.description: Work from anywhere in a compatible time zone. We have been fully remote since day one.

health.title: Health & wellness
health.description: Full medical, dental and vision coverage for you and your family, plus a monthly wellness stipend.

equipment.title: Top-tier equipment
equipment.description: MacBook Pro, display, peripherals and a home-office budget — your setup, your call.

learning.title: Learning budget
learning.description: $2,000 per year for courses, books, conferences and anything that makes you better at your craft.

vacation.title: Unlimited PTO
vacation.description: Minimum 20 days per year, no cap. We mean it — rest is part of the job.

equity.title: Meaningful equity
equity.description: Every full-time hire gets a real ownership stake in the company with a 10-year exercise window.

positions.title: Open positions
positions.description: We hire for slope, not intercept. If you are close to a role but not a perfect match — apply anyway.
positions.empty: No open roles in this department right now. Check back soon or send us a spontaneous application.

process.title: Our hiring process
process.description: Transparent, fast and respectful of your time. The whole loop usually takes 2–3 weeks.

apply.title: Application
apply.description: Send us your resume, GitHub or portfolio. We read every application ourselves — no ATS filters.

screening.title: Intro call
screening.description: 30 minutes with the hiring manager to talk about the role, your experience and your questions.

interview.title: Technical interview
interview.description: A practical, paid take-home or a live pairing session — whichever fits the role better.

offer.title: Offer
offer.description: Reference checks, a call with the founders and a written offer. We move fast once we decide.

cta.title: Don't see the right role?
cta.description: Send us a spontaneous application — tell us what you would build here and why. We read every message.
